Priya (product): Kicking off a small thread to align on prioritization for the routing/tenancy roadmap. Need clarity on must-have launch gates vs nice-to-have items. TL;DR: customers ask for hard residency + audit, infra wants phased rollout.

Ben (eng-arch): Short list of tradeoffs: per-tenant slices = stronger isolation and SLAs, but cost and operational surface area go up. Shared lanes + affinities = cheaper but weaker tail latency guarantees.

Ivy (eng-platform): From platform POV we can ship an initial affinity layer (soft-affinity + weighted routing) quickly. True hard isolation (dedicated pools) needs allocator work + billing changes. Estimate 8-10 wks for basic dedicated pools MVP.

Diego (sales): Enterprise pilots are asking for three guarantees: 1) data residency enforced 2) cutover rollback < 15m 3) audit logs with retention options. If we can't promise all, we need language for partial guarantees.

Lena (security): For residency enforcement we need cryptographic proof of residency and KMS key locality options. Also enforceable policy on cross-region fallback: must be explicit opt-in per contract.

Omar (finance): Important: we need a pricing model for Dedicated that covers 70-80% of committed cost. If Dedicated increases infra spend by ~30% (per earlier sims), margin needs to be baked into contracts.

Priya (product): Proposal for launch tiers (short):
- Phase A (Launch): Soft-affinity hosted + Dedicated beta limited to 5 customers, telemetry + canary automation
- Phase B: Dedicated GA with SLA template, tenant-evacuation playbook, billing adjustments
- Phase C: Private/VPC GA with KMS/HSM and residency enforcement

Ben (eng-arch): Additions to acceptance criteria:
- Routing precedence documented end-to-end (1: explicit tenant route, 2: affinity weight, 3: region fallback with consent)
- Evacuation contract: drain window <= 45m, rehydrate KV cache within <= 25m for warm routes
- Canary criteria: 0.5% traffic for 60m; rollback if error_rate > 0.8% or p95 latency regression > 20%

Ivy (eng-platform): Also require telemetry entitlements per tier:
- Hosted: basic metrics (latency, errors, token counts)
- Dedicated: per-tenant traces, token-level cost breakdown, audit stream retention 30d
- Private: full audit stream export + configurable retention

Diego (sales): Can we offer an "isolation add-on" for Hosted customers (monthly) that gives stronger affinity and 7d audit retention? Some mid-market customers want intermediate options.

Omar (finance): That add-on could be useful. Need a calculator that maps expected QPS and model size to cost delta. I can sketch a pricing matrix once we have infra deltas.

Lena (security): Reminder: any fallback that moves traffic across jurisdictions must be logged and require legal sign-off per customer contract. Add this to the Gate checklist.

Priya (product): Gate checklist draft (work in progress):
- SLOs finalized for Hosted/Dedicated (p95 token latency targets)
- Canary automation + rollback hooks in CI
- Evacuation playbook + runbook tested in staging
- Billing/pricing docs for Dedicated & add-on
- Security: KMS flow validated for Private, residency fallback policy documented
- Telemetry: per-tier export/retention verified

Ben (eng-arch): For SLOs propose: Hosted p95 token latency <= 320ms @ seq512; Dedicated p95 <= 200ms @ seq512. These are placeholders until runtime runbook validates.

Ivy (eng-platform): I'll add CI jobs: routing-canary, evacuation-smoke, telemetry-verify. Need owners for them.

Priya (product): Owners? @Ben for evacuation design, @Ivy for CI + telemetry, @Lena security sign-off, @Omar pricing + SLA numbers, @Diego customer validation. I'll be product owner of the PR.

Diego (sales): I'll validate the add-on concept with two pilots this week and report back.

Omar (finance): I'll produce a cost delta spreadsheet by Wed.

Lena (security): I'll draft the minimal threat model required for Private and Dedicated fallbacks by Thu.

Ben (eng-arch): One implementation note 5: fallback_policy needs a small DSL: allow list of fallback regions, consent flag, max hops, and telemetry flag. We'll add schema in the policy repo.

Ivy (eng-platform): Can we expose a toggle for "evacuation-speed" per tenant? Some customers want fast warmup at cost, others prefer slower. That affects autoscaler config.

Priya (product): Good idea. We can make that an optional contract parameter in Dedicated. Add to requirements doc.
